explanation: The same article closes the other side of the link. “1966 anti-Igbo pogrom”, at revision 1376650990, lead: “These events led to the secession of the eastern Nigerian region and the declaration of Biafra, which ultimately led to the Nigerian Civil War.” § Aftermath: “It also was the precursor to Ojukwu's declaration of Eastern Nigeria's secession from the federation as the Republic of Biafra, and the resulting Nigerian Civil War (1967–1970)”; and § Background, of the September killings: “It has been described as the most painful and provocative incident leading to the Nigeria-Biafra War.” `precondition-of` and not `caused`, because the cause the article puts next to the war is the secession and the declaration of Biafra, and this atlas holds neither: the pogrom is what the secession answered, one step back. `probable` under rule 22.
